correctness.rationale: For d>=3 the irreducible quadratic null cone and Fischer pairing characterize exactly which Walsh coefficient functionals vanish on degree-ell harmonics. Factorized hyperbolic generating functions prove all mixed Walsh weights occur, and explicit Taylor-coefficient identities treat both extreme weights with only the two stated exceptions. Each coefficient identity was algebraically reconstructed; an exact-rational Gegenbauer/Walsh checker independently passed 741 sectors for d=3..8, ell=0..18. The infinite theorem uses the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: This gives a complete exact-degree interpolation invariant for an infinite family of canonical spherical sampling sets. It identifies every missing Walsh data direction and proves a striking nonmonotonic rank dropout in the top character at degree d+2 followed by permanent recovery; unlike a small computed example, its uniform all-d/all-degree statement is structurally supported by a null-cone harmonic argument.
